evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Nicole: 'Hi, this is Nicole from Einstein moving, am I speaking with Katie?' Katie: 'Yes, yes.' [Later used: 'Are you ready to book, Katie?']
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Rep moved directly into logistics without the time-boxed framing and dependable quote promise.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep jumped straight into probing about the storage unit and property details.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Not applicable — no concerns were raised by the customer during step 2.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Not applicable — no concerns were raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Neither On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage were mentioned.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No version of 'Does that put those to rest?' was asked.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep opened with 'I can see here we're going to pickup items first from a storage unit' and systematically gathered: storage unit address/fullness, special items (none), appliance check, both property addresses and square footage (2000 sq ft), parking/driveway access at both locations, and garage details. All major logistics covered without a stated concern-led opening.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Neither packing acceptance nor box count was asked.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not reached — call routed cleanly to walkthrough before pricing discussion.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Not reached — call routed cleanly to walkthrough before ask.
evidence_quotes.virtual_walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identified 2000 sq ft as requiring walkthrough: 'usually we send out four movers and two trucks for a 2000 square footage home but we can do a virtual walkthrough, it's like a video call on your preferred time and date.' Customer agreed. Walkthrough scheduled for 6:00 PM same day via secure link sent by text. Clean handoff with confirmed date (October 17th) and time.

top_strength: Nicole cleanly and systematically gathered all logistics details (two addresses, square footage, storage contents, parking/access, special items) without meandering, and correctly routed a 2000 sq ft move to the virtual walkthrough process with confirmed date, time, and link delivery.
coaching_note: The quid pro quo framing (time-boxed offer + dependable quote promise) and the two-concerns question both disappeared entirely — they should land before probing even begins, and especially before step 4 detail collection on a call that will route to a walkthrough.
